blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Friday warned public officials against intentionally delaying government processes for personal gain, as it vowed to prioritize cases involving fixing and extortion. “Red tape is not always incompetence. Sometimes the delay is the product. Sometimes a requirement exists precisely so that someone can sell the exemption,” Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano said during the 2026 Ease of Doing Business Convention, as quoted in a statement. “When a delay is not a mistake but a business model—that is where the Ombudsman comes in,” he added.
